concepts.title: When agent access becomes the incident
concepts.research_question: Which role owns inventory, authorization policy, budget, containment, legal accountability, and board reporting when an agent’s access creates an incident?
concepts.confidentiality_rule: Default Chatham House-style discussion; no participant identity or affiliation may be connected to a remark outside the room.
concepts.research_consent: Event participation does not equal research consent. Before discussion, offer a separate opt-in form for deidentified thematic coding; request any attributable follow-up in a later source-specific consent process.
concepts.what_may_be_published: Aggregate themes, anonymized decision-rights map, unanswered questions, and disclosed participant-role counts when cell sizes are safe.
concepts.what_remains_off_record: Names, attendee list, company incidents, unpublished figures, architecture, legal advice, sponsor discussions, and any non-consented remark.
concepts.data_capture_method: Consent-coded facilitator template; no recording by default; two researchers reconcile deidentified notes; destroy non-consented notes after quality control.
concepts.follow_up_output: Research protocol, matched-interview invitations, and a public question brief—not a finding report.

sponsorship.conflict_risk: Security or identity vendors may dominate recruitment or turn the room into lead generation.
sponsorship.required_disclosure: Sponsor category, event funding, and all commercial relationships.
sponsorship.funding_findings_separation: Sponsor has no attendee-selection, facilitation, note, or output-approval role.
sponsorship.data_access_limits: No attendee list, notes, recordings, quotes, or contact data.
sponsorship.publication_independence: OFF controls the protocol and may publish inconvenient gaps.

concepts.title: Human approval, monitoring, and hard limits
concepts.research_question: Where does each oversight mechanism work, fail, or create unacceptable burden across action-risk tiers?
concepts.confidentiality_rule: Non-attributable discussion; scenario responses may be coded only under separate consent.
concepts.research_consent: Separate opt-in for anonymous scenario-response analysis; participants can join the room without contributing research data.
concepts.what_may_be_published: Scenario-level distributions if minimum cells are met, control tradeoff hypotheses, and the approved instrument.
concepts.what_remains_off_record: Workflow identities, incidents, personal performance, monitoring logs, employee data, and non-consented notes.
concepts.data_capture_method: Anonymous scenario cards linked only to broad role and region; facilitator records discussion themes separately.
concepts.follow_up_output: Pilot questionnaire for SURVEY-003 and protocol for a prospective workflow study.

sponsorship.conflict_risk: Monitoring vendors may define activity as safety.
sponsorship.data_access_limits: No cards, logs, identities, or notes to sponsor.
sponsorship.publication_independence: Burden and surveillance concerns must remain reportable.

concepts.title: Traceability, lawful anonymity, and responsibility
concepts.research_question: How much linkage is necessary to establish accountability without unnecessary surveillance or over-retention?
concepts.confidentiality_rule: Non-attributable by default; no legal advice or active-case discussion.
concepts.research_consent: Separate consent for anonymous proposition coding; attributable public follow-up must be a new interview.
concepts.what_may_be_published: A scope map of distinct positions, points of agreement, unresolved legal questions, and research needs.
concepts.what_remains_off_record: Client facts, investigations, privileged analysis, personal data, and non-consented policy positions.
concepts.data_capture_method: Predefined proposition cards, anonymous ranking, and reconciled thematic notes with jurisdiction labels.
concepts.follow_up_output: Counterposition research brief and public-panel design for PANEL-002.

sponsorship.conflict_risk: Advocacy or legal sponsors may favor a predetermined policy result.
sponsorship.data_access_limits: No identities, notes, rankings, or privileged material.

concepts.title: Global agent-governance implementation exchange
concepts.research_question: Which local legal and operating conditions materially change agent identity, authorization, audit, and shutdown practice?
concepts.participant_count: 10–14; no region represented by one person
concepts.confidentiality_rule: Private, non-attributable, multilingual where required; country and role cells published only when safe.
concepts.research_consent: Translated consent reviewed by qualified speakers; separate permission for coded comparative data and any quotation.
concepts.what_may_be_published: Region-scoped requirements, implementation questions, and verified public-source reading list; no representative regional claim.
concepts.what_remains_off_record: Identity, attendee list, private regulatory communications, company incidents, and untranslated remarks.
concepts.data_capture_method: Original-language structured worksheets, qualified translation review, and geography fields separated by speaker, organization, market, study, event, and regulation.
concepts.follow_up_output: Regional interview protocol and native-language source verification batches.

sponsorship.suitable_sponsor_category: International professional association or neutral foundation
sponsorship.conflict_risk: Sponsor may promote one jurisdiction or recruit only its members.
sponsorship.funding_findings_separation: OFF and local reviewers control method; sponsor cannot define regional conclusions.
sponsorship.data_access_limits: No participant contacts, original-language notes, or small cells.
sponsorship.publication_independence: Underrepresented and critical perspectives remain publishable.
